topics.name: Language-model steering and parameter-efficient adaptation
topics.summary: Game-based representations, activation interventions, and low-rank or temporary adapters alter model behavior without rebuilding the base network. Results across transfer and reasoning tasks show that update location and persistence strongly affect generalization.

topics.name: Reinforcement learning for language-model reasoning
topics.summary: Difficulty-aware sampling, critic guidance, multi-trace consensus, and policy distillation target the long chain of decisions in mathematical reasoning. Selective supervision and repeated attempts improve solution quality while compact distillation reduces deployment cost.

topics.name: Memory systems for language models and agents
topics.summary: Persistent memories, cache eviction, reconstructive retrieval, and editable model state address retention, deletion, and recovery. The recurring finding is that useful recall requires explicit controls for capacity, provenance, conflicts, and restoration.

topics.name: Efficient foundation-model inference and serving
topics.summary: Token pruning, attention and KV reuse, mixed precision, early exits, and idle-aware scheduling reduce computation for long-context and multimodal models. Evaluations emphasize preserving answer quality while lowering memory, latency, accelerator demand, or energy use.

topics.name: Research agents and evidence-grounded retrieval
topics.summary: Search planning, task-conditioned indexing, provenance links, domain retrieval, and adaptive tool acquisition support literature analysis and multimodal decisions. Across scientific, financial, and knowledge-intensive tasks, verifiable evidence matters more than fluent unsupported output.

topics.name: Agent evaluation and benchmark methodology
topics.summary: Executable environments, deterministic graders, judge calibration, trajectory tests, and system-level audits expose failures hidden by final-answer scores. The benchmarks span terminal work, multimodal tasks, computer use, and application harnesses, separating model errors from evaluation artifacts.

topics.name: Multi-agent coordination and self-evolving agents
topics.summary: Team workflows use reliability estimates, contribution tracking, changing communication graphs, and reusable skills to coordinate heterogeneous agents. Other systems version executable improvements and restrict descendant creation, linking autonomy to reviewable artifacts and controlled specialization.

topics.name: Post-training and policy learning for LLM agents
topics.summary: Verified outcomes, transition estimates, entropy contrasts, prompt portfolios, and self-comparison provide training signals for long-horizon agents. The methods improve exploration and reusable behavior while reducing reliance on dense labels or expensive on-policy interaction.

topics.name: AI safety governance and accountability
topics.summary: Policy instruments, institutional analysis, system-instruction audits, and safety benchmarks examine who sets criteria and who bears responsibility. Recurring recommendations include independent assessment, portable evidence, incident reporting, and metrics tied to real downstream behavior.

topics.name: Safety and robustness of deployed AI systems
topics.summary: Constrained controllers, rollout checks, adversarial training, memory attacks, energy attacks, and runtime reliability signals probe failures in external operations and specialized models. Results show that hard constraints and targeted monitoring help, but model geometry and specification quality remain decisive.

topics.name: Vision-language perception and reasoning
topics.summary: Risk recognition, geometric puzzles, spatial tools, absent-object checks, and pathology scenes reveal gaps between fluent language and dependable visual evidence. Training with localized features and structured spatial cues improves detail handling, but perceptual traps and constraint reasoning remain difficult.

topics.name: Multimodal retrieval, grounding, and long-video understanding
topics.summary: Cross-modal retrievers, evidence routers, persistent visual tokens, and query-specific frame selection are tested on clinical visits, sign videos, long clips, and image-text collections. Preserving temporal coverage and local visual support improves grounded answers while reducing context cost.

topics.name: Medical image understanding and reconstruction
topics.summary: Radiology, pathology, segmentation, volumetric completion, artifact correction, and brain-tumor analysis use task-specific supervision and pretrained visual features. Across modalities and cohorts, retaining anatomy, handling missing inputs, and testing transfer are more informative than a single aggregate score.

topics.name: Clinical AI assessment and reliability
topics.summary: Clinical imaging and speech systems convert observations into structured findings, symptom scores, or early diagnostic judgments. Expert-aligned labels, subgroup coverage, calibrated deferral, and drift monitoring repeatedly matter for safe use beyond headline accuracy.

topics.name: Biosignal decoding and neuroimaging workflows
topics.summary: Surface-EMG and EEG systems align representations across people, sessions, and institutions, while agentic neuroimaging pipelines automate conversion, quality checks, and reporting. The studies emphasize label savings, privacy, long-stream processing, and reliable handoffs to analysts.

topics.name: Embodied world models and cross-embodiment transfer
topics.summary: Behavior traces, ordered motion structures, paired videos, and predictive latent models help transfer action knowledge across bodies, viewpoints, layouts, and hardware. Imagined rollouts and calibrated low-precision execution improve planning efficiency while reducing target data or deployment cost.

topics.name: Robot manipulation, affordances, and tactile control
topics.summary: Dexterous policies combine demonstrations, offline corrections, RGB-D affordances, tactile histories, force estimates, and adaptive control for contact-rich tasks. Real-robot evaluations show that recovery, hardware awareness, and informative feedback improve performance under object variation and execution drift.

topics.name: Human-aware robot navigation
topics.summary: Aerial and ground robots infer human motion, body configuration, and social intent from sparse visual or LiDAR observations. Geometric scene representations and leg-aware policies improve both recognition and navigation when people are moving targets rather than static obstacles.

topics.name: Graph representation learning and graph infrastructure
topics.summary: Graph indexes, structural alignment, temporal filtering, topology-aware tokens, and inductive encoders support retrieval, classification, clustering, and evolving-network prediction. The shared emphasis is preserving connectivity, semantics, and transferability as graphs become incomplete, heterogeneous, or larger.

topics.name: Black-box and combinatorial model optimization
topics.summary: Bayesian surrogates, history-conditioned preferences, evolutionary reformulations, feature-subspace search, and solver-aware candidate generation guide expensive discrete decisions. Experiments favor structured search and validation-aware selection when evaluations or feasible options are limited.

topics.name: Coreset selection and robust data summarization
topics.summary: Graph sampling and federated robust selection produce compact data summaries under scale, privacy, and noise constraints. Their guarantees and optimization procedures aim to retain task-relevant structure without requiring every example at every node.

topics.name: Policy learning under large or long-run constraints
topics.summary: Structured sampling, importance weighting, actor-critic estimation, and neural primal-dual updates address enormous action spaces and persistent constraints. The analyses balance exploration, statistical error, policy improvement, and constraint violation rather than optimizing reward alone.

topics.name: Statistical learning theory and uncertainty
topics.summary: Theoretical analyses connect optimization schedules, dependence estimation, neural approximation, robustness, incomplete observations, and distribution change to finite-sample behavior. The results provide convergence rates, correction terms, uncertainty guarantees, or detection rules for models operating outside idealized data conditions.

topics.name: Scientific machine learning for dynamical systems
topics.summary: Neural operators, differentiable surrogates, learned preconditioners, force fields, and physics-informed residuals accelerate PDE, stability, quantum, magnetic, and thermal computations. Geometry, events, couplings, and conservation-related structure help preserve useful dynamics where generic sequence models fail.

topics.name: Causal inference and individualized effects
topics.summary: Mediation forests, debiased score tests, topological summaries, and sparse influence models estimate heterogeneous treatment effects and distinguish relevant dependencies from predictive correlations. The methods target interpretable effect modifiers, policy value, and more faithful temporal explanations.

topics.name: Computational choice and experiment design
topics.summary: Heterogeneous choice models and Bayesian experimental design are used to infer preferences, latent mechanisms, and informative environments. Performance depends on sample size, behavioral determinism, and whether selected experiments target the parameters that matter for the final decision.

topics.name: Recommendation, personalization, and market optimization
topics.summary: Generative recommenders, semantic user representations, sequential preference models, uplift fields, and pricing or auction agents convert behavioral signals into personalized decisions. Results weigh retrieval quality, causal allocation, user response, and serving or market efficiency together.

topics.name: Image enhancement, restoration, and watermark removal
topics.summary: No-reference quality prediction, personalized color adaptation, wavelet restoration, diffusion refinement, and state-space processing improve images without relying on paired targets. Evaluations emphasize perceptual fidelity, private personalization, and removal of embedded signals without damaging natural content.

topics.name: 3D reconstruction, avatars, and neural scene representation
topics.summary: Meshes, Gaussian primitives, neural shading, articulated priors, camera adaptation, and ordered scene attributes recover or generate editable 3D and 4D content. The applications span human avatars, dynamic rendering, novel views, atomic shapes, and compact video scenes.

topics.name: Generative media for vision, audio, and video
topics.summary: Screenplay skill extraction, product ideation, structured speech and singing synthesis, contextual preference signals, and efficient visual diffusion all add explicit structure to open-ended generation. Evaluations consider novelty, controllability, interaction quality, temporal consistency, and compute cost.

topics.name: Remote sensing and environmental monitoring
topics.summary: Satellite, hyperspectral, radar, street-level, fiber-acoustic, and vessel data support agriculture, flooding, infrastructure, weather, and maritime monitoring. Context retrieval, multisensor fusion, synthetic minority data, and onboard processing improve coverage while exposing sensitivity to clouds, imbalance, and changing scenes.

topics.name: Visual security, deepfake detection, and moderation
topics.summary: Distillation, adversarial training, temporal hypergraphs, multimodal forgery cues, and transformation stress tests examine robustness of visual and speech safety systems. Dataset composition and simple input changes can alter confidence or moderation outcomes, motivating layered evaluation.

topics.name: Interpretability and explanatory machine learning
topics.summary: Contrastive scores, counterfactual feature changes, sparse activation interventions, and automatically discovered concepts explain predictions through competing classes or human-readable directions. The studies use these tools to diagnose ambiguity, bias, similarity, and decision boundaries.

topics.name: Visual analytics and human-centered interfaces
topics.summary: Interactive dashboards, onboarding views, uncertainty encodings, projection diagnostics, and shared spatial workspaces help people inspect algorithms and compare alternatives. User studies and visual metrics show that layout, distortion, and feedback design affect trust, comprehension, and action.

topics.name: Formal schemas, provenance, and process mining
topics.summary: Event-log forecasting, scientific protocols, communication models, and agent workflows become more reproducible when entities, steps, constraints, and lineage are explicit. Structured representations support consistency checks, refinement synthesis, and clearer separation between data quality and model behavior.

topics.name: Human-centered AI, education, and conversational behavior
topics.summary: Studies of tutoring, requirements learning, instructional media, qualitative coding, emotional dialogue, and long-term assistants evaluate effects on people rather than text quality alone. Human review reveals tradeoffs among helpfulness, autonomy, agreement, identity stability, and sustained user outcomes.

topics.name: Computational linguistics and literary studies
topics.summary: Morphological production, discourse prosody, hidden-state structure, literary transformation, and World Englishes are analyzed with benchmarks, speech measurements, and representation probing. The recurring concern is how models encode linguistic variation, narrative form, and prestige norms beyond surface fluency.

topics.name: Privacy-preserving learning and machine unlearning
topics.summary: Federated defenses, targeted forgetting, influence tracking, unlearnable text, edge execution, and private desktop interfaces reduce exposure of sensitive data or capabilities. The methods measure the tension between removing leakage, maintaining utility, and operating with limited network trust.

topics.name: Scientific discovery and materials modeling
topics.summary: Computer-assisted proof search, mechanism-focused scientific retrieval, crystal generation, electron microscopy, and structure-aware representations support hypothesis formation and materials prediction. Physical constraints and reusable abstractions improve transfer when paired labels or direct experimental coverage are scarce.

topics.name: Mechanism design and strategic AI agents
topics.summary: Audit policies, reputation penalties, complaint mechanisms, and online signaling schemes steer agents when private information or truthful confidence cannot be assumed. The analyses provide behavioral, welfare, or regret guarantees under strategic interaction.

topics.name: Theory of mind and social reasoning
topics.summary: Human and language-model studies connect inferred goals, information value, beliefs, and judgments about minded entities to observable behavior. The results suggest that social reasoning can be reshaped by alignment or observation policy without disappearing altogether.

topics.name: Semantic communication for robotics and edge AI
topics.summary: Task-conditioned image coding, semantic beamforming, and robot-edge testbeds transmit compact visual meaning instead of raw sensor streams. Mapping and object interaction remain useful when bandwidth and compute are constrained, provided the retained semantics match the task.

topics.name: AI-assisted software engineering and program repair
topics.summary: Coding agents are evaluated on legacy migration, architecture, RTL design, issue diagnosis, regression testing, and formal repair. Repository context, executable checks, proof obligations, and deletion-sensitive tests expose defects that fluent patches or passing surface tests can miss.

topics.name: Symbolic program synthesis and formal methods
topics.summary: Language models are paired with SPARQL, answer-set, and Lean feedback to construct or repair executable symbolic artifacts. Query correction, theory synthesis, schema constraints, and dependency checks improve reliability by making generated changes mechanically testable.

topics.name: Domain adaptation and transfer learning
topics.summary: Reliability-weighted experts and consensus references select models or hyperparameters when target labels are scarce, especially for cellular perturbation and cross-domain prediction. The methods use measured structure, perturbations, or agreement among source models to reduce blind transfer failures.

topics.name: Misinformation and belief modeling
topics.summary: AI-generated counterspeech and computational simulations examine how messages affect elaboration, perceived effectiveness, and belief change. Realistic initial states and audience context are important because generic agents can reproduce neither human responses nor intervention outcomes reliably.

topics.name: Cross-modal face recognition
topics.summary: Face identity representations are aligned across speech, viewpoints, time, and degraded imagery using cross-modal embeddings and collaborative restoration. The applications include verification, retrieval, and re-identification when observations are incomplete or low quality.

topics.name: Geometric and algebraic machine learning
topics.summary: Structured mathematical representations support algebraic search, topology-aware modeling, symmetry handling, and reusable geometric-learning software. The work connects formal mathematical structure with practical tools for model construction, discovery, and analysis.
